values: Materials and settings｜All data is fictional and editorially designed

You do paper requirement, cost and model comparisons for a fictional customer only. The amounts and rules are exercise settings, not market quotations, solar technical standards or personal investment advice.

S1｜The customer's budget is 46000 yuan and the requirement states 12 PV-A modules at 450W nameplate each. Electricity bills, shading, weather, structural and electrical conclusions, incentives and loan eligibility are all not provided, so annual generation, savings or payback cannot be estimated.

S2｜The V1 quotation: 12 PV-A pieces at 1600 yuan each, 8000 yuan for the inverter, 12000 yuan for supports and installation, 1800 yuan for the paper documentation service and 1000 yuan for transport; the exercise assumes each listed amount includes tax, with no separate tax, and the 1000 yuan discount applies only to the option listed in V1/V2. Rooftop reinforcement is not within the V1 scope, and whether it is needed was previously unknown.

S3｜The technical party notifies that rooftop reinforcement of 6000 yuan must be added (a tax-inclusive price given in the exercise), while the other listed items and the 1000 discount are unchanged, forming V2; the customer has not approved the overrun. V1 may no longer be called the confirmed total price of the whole project.

S4｜The V2 attached component list is actually 10 A450W pieces and 2 B400W pieces, inconsistent with the 12 A pieces in S1, the amount is not yet revised, and both substitution applicability and customer confirmation are unknown. Sales can only recalculate and hand over the issues; models and structural and electrical matters are checked by the corresponding technical party, and discounts, overruns and contracts are confirmed by the authorizer and customer, with no commitment that construction or operation is possible.
Tasks and output

List the requirement and quotation item-by-item calculations per S1/S2, calculate the discounted total, the gap against the budget and the total nameplate power of the requirement, and distinguish kW from annual generation.

Calculate the changed total and the overrun per S3; compare the component list and nameplate total per S4, and record unrevised costs, missing confirmations and professional issues. Seal the first draft first, then open the answer.
Reference answer (complete it independently first, then look)

S2 components 12×1600=19200 yuan; the original five items 19200+8000+12000+1800+1000=42000 yuan, minus the 1000 discount = 41000 yuan, 5000 yuan below the 46000 budget. S1 requirement 12×450W=5400W=5.4kW, a nameplate total only, and it cannot be counted as annual generation or savings.

S3 V2 is 42000+6000−1000=47000 yuan, 1000 yuan over the 46000 budget; 6000 more than V1. Record the added reinforcement, the unchanged discount and the unapproved status, and pass them to the quotation authorizer and the customer, without deleting costs or automatically increasing the budget.

S4 list 10×450+2×400=5300W=5.3kW, 0.1kW less than the S1 requirement of 5.4kW, with 2 pieces of a different model. A similar nameplate total cannot be taken as proof of substitution; the V2 amount has not yet been corrected for the list, and 47000 is only the result of the cost conditions set in S3, not the final quotation after the model correction. Pass models, structural and electrical matters and output inputs to the technical party for verification, pass the new quotation to the authorizer for verification, then explain the conditions to the customer; the current status is pending verification and pending approval.
Boundaries and review

Use the S1–S4 paper documents only; do not contact real customers, take private bills, sign contracts or make payments, or climb onto roofs to wire or test equipment. The reinforcement requirement is a prompt assumption, and the exercise cannot judge real structures. Unknown generation, savings, loan, tax and incentive conditions and model applicability must not be written as zero or made into guarantees; the exercise's price-to-budget arithmetic is not a purchasing recommendation.
